messages:
deploy-bot: Promotion paused: artifact registry returned 429 for image redwood/runtime:2026-03-21-abc123 — attempting retries (3/5). Details: https://console.pkg/redwood/runtime/abc123 :warning:

devops-alex: saw this in eu-west earlier, registry is throttling ephemeral pushes. can we fall back to mirror?

sre-jen: +1 on mirror. We also have a short-lived artifact-cache we can enable in the chart values (helm). If we enable with cache.enabled=true it will pull from a regional mirror and backfill.

release-ryan: what's the risk for the release notes? If we switch to mirror we need to document registry change and the image digest pinned.

eng-lead-maya: decision needed: hotpatch to enable cache & proceed, or pin to previous image digest and finish release window? Which has lower blast radius?

devops-alex: pinning is safest. Command to pin:

```bash
helm upgrade mysvc ./charts/mysvc --set image.tag=sha256:deadbeef1234 --reuse-values --namespace prod
```

That will avoid re-pulling the new push. If we hotpatch cache it's a config change live; lower safe but reversible quickly.

sre-jen: hotpatch path:

```yaml
# patch values
cache:
  enabled: true
  mirrorRegistry: eu-mirror.pkg.redwood
```

then `helm upgrade --reuse-values` to apply. Rollback is `helm rollback`.

release-ryan: if we pin, we must add a line to release notes: "Using pinned runtime image sha256:deadbeef1234 due to upstream registry push throttling; will re-promote new image after registry stability." Also include CV for customers with image digests.

devops-alex: timeline: can pin now, promote later. Pin + small release note update is fastest.

eng-lead-maya: agree. do pin + update notes. who will run the helm pin and update the notes?

devops-alex: I can run the pin in 5 mins and open a PR to /docs/releases with the note. @release-ryan can you review the PR?

release-ryan: on it, will review quick.

oncall-bot: Reminder: deploying outside change window requires owner sign-off. This is within the scheduled maintenance window (22:00-23:00 UTC), proceeding under incident-exemption.

sre-jen: after pinning we'll monitor pod image and pull success. If we see image pull errors persist for the pinned digest, we'll fallback to enabling cache and revert in 15m.

devops-alex: pinned and promoted, helm output: "Release "mysvc" has been upgraded" :tada:

release-ryan: PR open: https://git.redwood/release-notes/PR-432 — added the pinned-image note and rationale.

eng-lead-maya: thanks team. keep an eye on latency/restarts for next 30m. follow up in #incidents if anything spikes.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete for release v1.12.3 (pinned). No rollout failures detected in 2m. :shipit:
